reviews.title: Error code popping up
reviews.text: Every time I open the app an ERROR pops up “Oops, something went wrong! (PE_1)”. Can you please fix this issue it’s really annoying. I tried logging out and logging back in. Removed the app and reinstalled again. But still the issue is not fixed. I love this app and hope that it will be fixed soon.
